newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers $20 mln supplier credits to Colombia.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers $20 mln supplier credits to Colombia.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Wednesday said it authorized $20 million in credit guarantees for sales of U.S. farmgoods to Colombia under the Supplier Credit Guarantee Program for fiscal 1997.
The program is an adaption of the GSM-102 program to assist exporters of U.S. agricultural commodities who want to provide relatively short-term credit to their importers.
The eligible commodities include vegetable oil, cotton, meat, fruit, vegetables and dairy products.
USDA said $10 million had been allocated to cover those commodities and that details about the allocation of the remaining $10 million would be issued later.
